newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal public sector borrowing up 12 pct Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Portugal public sector borrowing up 12 pct Jan-Aug.

text.p: Portugal's public sector borrowing rose some 12 percent to 672.3 billion escudos in the first eight months of 1996, compared with 601.7 billion in the same period last year, the Bank of Portugal said.
Net borrowing fell 28.3 billion escudos in August, the Bank said in its latest monthly bulletin. It gave no further figures.
The state budget deficit is expected to narrow to four percent of gross domestic product in 1996 from 4.9 percent a year ago.
